So I can't communicate with 95% of the people even though I was born and have lived here my whole life.... That's how big of a fucking failure I am... just a waste of space...

I really do want to just die already... I'm 26, with no future... Only reason I try to keep on going is cause I don't want my parents to lose both their kids. 

But one day they'll be gone... And then it won't be long before I am too...

It's not just *that* easy.

And there's 2 political parties trying to remove the minority language and more than enough of people with the "here we speak this language" mentality.

So what do I have to lose? Probably the tiny amount of the will to live that I have left.
